description: Point-in-time observation lineage for WTILS research artifacts

event_time.description: The time of the event itself

original_publish_time.description: When the source originally published this information. MUST NOT be used as wm_first_seen_time.

source_observed_time.description: When the source was observed by WM. MUST NOT be replaced by retrieval time.

wm_first_seen_time.description: First time WorldMonitor ingested this observation

webhook_emitted_time.description: When the source webhook was emitted

analyst_available_time.description: When result became available to analyst

research_snapshot_time.description: When the research snapshot was taken

outcome_time.description: When the actual outcome occurred (for prediction evaluation)

rules: original_publish_time MUST NOT be used as wm_first_seen_time.
source_observed_time MUST NOT be replaced by retrieval time.
All timestamps nullable. None may be inferred.
Seeded vs live observation separation required.
Null timestamps remain null through all pipeline stages.
